name: Kubernetes (kubespray)
label: kubernetes_kubespray
description: Vanilla upstream Kubernetes on Ubuntu 26.04 bare metal via kubespray v2.32.0: 1/3/5 control-plane nodes with stacked etcd, scalable workers, kube-vip API VIP, MetalLB L2, local-path storage.

inputs.label: control_plane_server_type
inputs.name: control_plane_server_type
inputs.helpText: Control-plane nodes (API server, etcd). Production: 4+ cores, 16+ GB RAM, SSD. Fixed after create.

inputs.label: worker_server_type
inputs.name: worker_server_type
inputs.helpText: Server type of every worker node (runs the workloads). Fixed after create.

inputs.label: os_template
inputs.name: os_template
inputs.helpText: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS wait-for-SSH template (ubuntu-26-04-lts-waitforssh). Fixed after create.

inputs.label: control_plane_count
inputs.name: control_plane_count
inputs.helpText: Control-plane nodes with stacked etcd: 1, 3 or 5. Change by 2 per edit, with no other change in that edit.

inputs.label: worker_count
inputs.name: worker_count
inputs.helpText: Worker nodes (1-100). Edit to scale out/in; removed nodes are drained first (MetalSoft picks which leave).

inputs.label: kube_version
inputs.name: kube_version
inputs.helpText: Kubernetes version. Edit to upgrade: one minor at a time, never down, no other change in the same edit.

inputs.label: kube_proxy_mode
inputs.name: kube_proxy_mode
inputs.helpText: kube-proxy mode: iptables (default, tested on Ubuntu 26.04) or nftables (experimental). Fixed after create.

inputs.label: pod_network_cidr
inputs.name: pod_network_cidr
inputs.helpText: Pod network (Calico), /12 to /20. Must not overlap node, service or client networks. Fixed after create.

inputs.label: service_network_cidr
inputs.name: service_network_cidr
inputs.helpText: Service (ClusterIP) network, /12 to /24. Must not overlap the pod or node networks. Fixed after create.

inputs.label: cluster_dns_domain
inputs.name: cluster_dns_domain
inputs.helpText: In-cluster DNS domain (<svc>.<ns>.svc.<domain>), not the site DNS zone. Keep cluster.local. Fixed after create.

inputs.label: metrics_server_enabled
inputs.name: metrics_server_enabled
inputs.helpText: Install metrics-server (kubectl top, autoscaling). Add-only: switching it off later is refused.

inputs.label: local_path_provisioner_enabled
inputs.name: local_path_provisioner_enabled
inputs.helpText: Install local-path-provisioner as the default StorageClass (node-local disk, no replication). Add-only.

inputs.label: gateway_api_crds_enabled
inputs.name: gateway_api_crds_enabled
inputs.helpText: Install the Gateway API CRDs (standard channel, no controller). Add-only.

inputs.label: metallb_enabled
inputs.name: metallb_enabled
inputs.helpText: Install MetalLB (L2) for LoadBalancer Services from the 4 reserved IPs (output lb_pool_ranges). Add-only.

inputs.label: drain_timeout_minutes
inputs.name: drain_timeout_minutes
inputs.helpText: Per-node drain timeout for scale-in and upgrades (1-30 min).

inputs.label: drain_policy
inputs.name: drain_policy
inputs.helpText: When a drain times out: respect-pdb fails the edit (nothing removed); force-after-timeout evicts anyway.

inputs.label: converge_generation
inputs.name: converge_generation
inputs.helpText: Raise it (e.g. +1) to re-run the full kubespray converge: repair drift, apply new site settings. Never lower.

inputs.label: admin_credential_generation
inputs.name: admin_credential_generation
inputs.helpText: Raise it to rotate the admin kubeconfig (old one stops working). Never lower it.

outputs.label: api_url
outputs.name: api_url
outputs.helpText: Kubernetes API URL (https://<api name or VIP>:6443).

outputs.label: api_vip
outputs.name: api_vip
outputs.helpText: API virtual IP (kube-vip, ARP) on the cluster network.

outputs.label: api_fqdn
outputs.name: api_fqdn
outputs.helpText: API DNS name; empty when the site has no DNS provisioning for it.

outputs.label: admin_kubeconfig
outputs.name: admin_kubeconfig
outputs.helpText: kubeconfig of the extension's admin identity (cluster-admin via its own binding; revocable).

outputs.label: admin_kubeconfig_expires
outputs.name: admin_kubeconfig_expires
outputs.helpText: Expiry (UTC) of the admin kubeconfig certificate; edits renew it when < 30 days remain.

outputs.label: admin_credential
outputs.name: admin_credential
outputs.helpText: Admin identity name and group (revoke: delete its ClusterRoleBinding).

outputs.label: kubernetes_version
outputs.name: kubernetes_version
outputs.helpText: Kubernetes version running on the control plane.

outputs.label: kubespray_version
outputs.name: kubespray_version
outputs.helpText: kubespray release used by this extension version.

outputs.label: lb_pool_ranges
outputs.name: lb_pool_ranges
outputs.helpText: IP range(s) reserved for LoadBalancer Services (MetalLB), first-last.

outputs.label: cluster_status
outputs.name: cluster_status
outputs.helpText: ready, or degraded: <problems> from the last run's health check.

outputs.label: etcd_last_snapshot
outputs.name: etcd_last_snapshot
outputs.helpText: Last etcd snapshot taken by the extension (node:path, time).

configVars.label: site_kubespray_overrides
configVars.name: site_kubespray_overrides
configVars.helpText: Site-admin kubespray group_vars (YAML/JSON or base64); protected keys rejected. Applied on create/converge.

configVars.label: site_dns_servers
configVars.name: site_dns_servers
configVars.helpText: Up to 3 comma-separated upstream DNS servers for cluster DNS. Empty: use the nodes' own resolvers.

configVars.label: site_ntp_servers
configVars.name: site_ntp_servers
configVars.helpText: Comma-separated NTP servers for the nodes (chrony). Empty: site NTP servers, else Ubuntu pool.

configVars.label: site_admin_cert_validity_days
configVars.name: site_admin_cert_validity_days
configVars.helpText: Validity in days (60-365) of the admin kubeconfig certificate issued by the extension.

configVars.label: site_auto_renew_certificates
configVars.name: site_auto_renew_certificates
configVars.helpText: Renew control-plane certificates monthly on the nodes (kubespray auto_renew_certificates).

configVars.label: site_backup_retention_count
configVars.name: site_backup_retention_count
configVars.helpText: etcd and kubeadm backups kept on each control-plane node (1-100).

configVars.label: site_ansible_forks
configVars.name: site_ansible_forks
configVars.helpText: Parallel SSH connections used by kubespray runs (5-200).
